profile.headline: Staff Engineer | Platform, Integrations & AI-Assisted Delivery | TypeScript, AWS, Event-Driven | Fintech | Berlin
profile.summary:
Backend engineer with 15+ years building distributed systems. TypeScript and Python today, Java before that, on AWS throughout.

Most of my work is service integration and distributed systems, with a bias toward the failure cases rather than the happy path. One integration layer I reworked around event-driven messaging and the transactional outbox pattern saw integration-related incidents drop 80%.

I also work on the organisational side of architecture: API and event-driven standards teams actually follow, ADRs, agreement across teams that don’t report to each other. And lately on automation that compounds, including agentic tooling and workflows.

positions.title: Tech Leader
positions.description:
(2009-2010) Lifia - Universia Guía de Empresas Españolas (http://guiaempresas.universia.es/) - About: using Struts2, DWR, Hibernate, Spring. Responsibilities: Tech Leader, architect and analyst developer.

(2010) Lifia – Universia - Scalability and Performance for the Content Manager. About: configuring Alfresco multimaster cluster with Load balancing, high availability. Responsibilites: tech leader and developer.

(2010-2011) Lifia – Portales Minplan. About: using Alfresco and JbossPortal. Responsibilities: project leader.

(2011-2012) Lifia – Mantenimiento Gestor de Contenidos Universia. Responsibilities: Project leader.

(2012-2016) Lifia – Idemplan-PIP. (http://pip.minplan.gob.ar/) Geographic Information System for Ministerio de Planificación de la Nación. About: using Geoserver, Geonetwork, PostgresSQL with PostGis and Spring, Hibernate, CAS. Responsibilities: tech leader, architect and developer in a scrum project.

positions.title: Java Senior Developer
positions.description:
(2005-2006) Nectia – Tiendas Paris (http://paris.cl) java migration project – Santiago – Chile. About: using IBM WebSphere Commerce. Responsabilities: java developer working at client office in Santiago de Chile.

(2006, 2007) Lifia – Nectia - Post Venta Almacenes Paris (Chile) remote project - La Plata – Buenos Aires. About: using J2EE and JBPM, Hibernate, Spring. Responsabilities: developer in scrum project.

(2007-2008) Lifia – Nectia – Personal credits project for Coopeuch Ltda (http://www.coopeuch.cl). About: using J2EE technologies. Responsabilities: developer in scrum project, participating in decision making of the application architecture. 

(2008) Lifia – Portal Universia.es (http://www.universia.es/) – Content Managment. About: concentrate information about 25 countries. Using Alfresco as CRM and J2EE to integrate with different platforms. Responsabilities: developer in a scrum project, taking model design decisions and architecture decisions.

(2008 - 2009) Lifia – Portal de Innovacion CIC – About: using Alfresco and JBossPortal. Responsabilities: architect and tech leader. Working in co-participation with developers at Instituto de Investigación en Informática LIDI.

(2009) Lifia – Portal de Canal7 y Medios Públicos – About: using J2EE, Alfresco and JbossPortal. Responsabilities: developer.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
(2003 – 2005) Lifia – Laboratorio de Investigación y Formación Informática Avanzada, pasantía otorgada por la Facultad de Ciencias Exactas; La Plata – Buenos Aires. About: research project about mobile user interfaces and aspects using J2ME, AspectJ y Superwaba (Java). – Research project about Context Awareness in mobile applications using VisualWorks7 (Smalltalk). Responsabilities: researcher.

(2004-2005) Lifia – Training/workshop design and delivery for institutions and companies. Topics: Programación Orientada Objetos (POO), POO design, Pattern design O.O., Dictates: Ministerio de Economía de la Nación, HEXACTA (www.hexacta.com), Facultad de Informática (UNLP). Responsabilities: teacher.
